South Korea.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile, South Korea and US hold joint drills
South Korea.summary: South Korea and the US have launched joint military drills in response to North Korea's recent missile tests. The drills, which involve air, land, and sea exercises, were conducted in the South-west of the peninsula. North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un has threatened to take 'corresponding actions' in response to the drills.

South Korea.title: South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol meets with NATO chief in Seoul
South Korea.summary: South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol has met with NATO chief Jens Stoltenberg in Seoul. The meeting is part of a broader effort to strengthen bilateral ties between South Korea and NATO, with the two sides discussing cooperation on defense and security issues.

South Korea.title: Protesters in Seoul clash with police over anti-pension reform
South Korea.summary: Protesters in Seoul have clashed with police over government plans to reform the pension system. The protesters, who are opposed to the proposed reforms, have blocked roads and burned rubbish in the streets. The government has vowed to push through the reforms, despite opposition from workers and pensioners.

Japan.title: Japan's Ransomware Attack Exposes Over 6,000 People's Personal Data
Japan.summary: A ransomware attack on a Japanese company has exposed personal data of over 6,000 individuals, sparking concerns about cybersecurity in Japan.

Japan.title: Tokyo Sees Rise in COVID-19 Cases Amid New Omicron Subvariant
Japan.summary: Tokyo has reported a significant increase in COVID-19 cases due to the spread of a new Omicron subvariant, prompting concerns about a potential new wave of infections.

Japan.title: Anti-Nuclear Protesters Clash with Police in Tokyo
Japan.summary: Anti-nuclear protesters clashed with police in Tokyo, highlighting the ongoing debate about Japan's energy policy and the role of nuclear power
